test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-II Official Paper (Held On: 02 May, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Direction: Select the option that expresses the given sentence in direct speech.**

Somnath said that they had been there for two-and-a-half years and were going to stay another ten months.

options.text: Somnath was saying, "We has been here for two-and-a-half years. We are going to stay another ten months."
Somnath said, "We have been here for two-and-a-half years. We are going to stay another ten months."
Somnath had said , "We have been here for two-and-a-half years. We were going to stay another ten months."
Somnath said, "He have been here for two-and-a-half years. We are going to stay another ten months."

solution:
The correct answer is **"Somnath said, 'We have been here for two-and-a-half years. We are going to stay another ten months.'"**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• The rules for changing Indirect Speech to Direct Speech:
 
 
• The given sentence is in Past Tense.
 
• The verb tense changes from **"had been"** to** "have been"** and** "were going to stay"** to **"are going to stay" **because the reported speech is still true in the present.
 
• Insert the commas and inverted commas.
 
• We must use that in the sentence of indirect speech.
 
• The reporting verb asked is changed in said to as per the nature of the sentence.
 
• The pronoun "they" changes to "we" because the speaker is reporting what Somnath said from his perspective.
 
• The sentence uses quotation marks to show where the reported speech begins and ends..
 
 
 
• The correct answer is Option 2.

 

**Correct sentence**: **"Somnath said, 'We have been here for two-and-a-half years. We are going to stay another ten months.'"**
